name: Hanan
overview: Hanan is a male figure identified as a non-Levite leader mentioned in Nehemiah 10:22. He appears among those who sealed a solemn covenant recorded in Nehemiah 10:1-27. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, his leadership role outside the Levitical order is notable.
namesAndTitles: The name Hanan means 'gracious' as noted in Nehemiah 10:22. This proper name does not appear to have been given directly by God but reflects a common Hebrew personal name of the time.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Hanan is a descendant of Jacob according to Nehemiah 10:22. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hanan's significance lies in his role as a leader who participated in the covenant renewal among the returned exiles. His inclusion on the sealed document underscores his commitment to the communal reforms and restoration efforts under Nehemiah’s leadership. Being a non-Levite leader highlights the involvement of various Israelite groups in this crucial moment of spiritual renewal.
